name: VeriFlow
description: Pay-per-signal crypto risk-regime signals (RISK_ON / RISK_OFF for BTC and ETH) for AI agents, sold over x402 in CCD. Every signal is committed on Concordium as a SHA-256 hash before its outcome is known, so the track record cannot be edited or cherry-picked. Buyers first prove with Concordium Verify & Access V1 (zero-knowledge) that they are 18+ and not resident in a restricted country; VeriFlow learns nothing else. Not investment advice.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status is Active + card SHA-256 equals metadata_hash.

skills.name: Buy a signal (x402)
skills.description: Live x402 terms for the latest RISK_ON / RISK_OFF signal for BTC or ETH: pay about 1 testnet CCD at /signal/{asset} from your own wallet, fees sponsored. The payer's owner must first pass a zero-knowledge eligibility check; payTo is this agent's on-chain agentWallet.
examples: How do I buy a signal?

skills.name: Verify a signal
skills.description: Read a commitment's anchor from Concordium and check that the signal content hashes to it and was anchored within a day of its data close.

skills.name: Track record
skills.description: Hit rate of anchored signals whose 7-day horizon has passed, each asset-day counted once.

skills.name: On-chain commitments
skills.description: Every issued signal with the Concordium transaction that anchors it.

skills.name: Check buyer eligibility
skills.description: Whether a Concordium account has passed the zero-knowledge eligibility check (Verify & Access V1: age >= 18, not resident in a restricted country).
